text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of what people write. Another common example is translation, where computers change text from one language into another. NLP is also used for sentiment analysis, which means finding out if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions in a helpful way. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology is becoming smarter and easier to use.
